verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents a free migration app that moves code and users from Bitbucket Server/Data Center to Cloud, plus a Cloud trial matched to Data Center license terms, directly addressing self-hosted-to-cloud migration. However, this only covers migration from Bitbucket's own self-hosted products, not from other platforms (e.g. GitHub, GitLab, SVN), which the story explicitly requests. Missing for 10: migration tooling from third-party platforms, independent/hands-on validation of the migration app's reliability, and details on user/permissions migration fidelity.
